lead: Boundary surveys, marking out building sites and recording what was built. Nine people work here, and on most mornings five of them are out on site.

people.title: Andrea Brandstätter
people.text: Boundary surveys and the district's fixed survey points.

image.alternative: Portrait of Andrea Brandstätter, a woman in her late forties with shoulder-length brown hair and a navy jumper.

people.title: Milan Hrdlicka
people.text: Height measurements and monitoring of structures, including the Ellbach bridge twice a year.

image.alternative: Portrait of Milan Hrdlicka, a man in his fifties with grey stubble and a dark quilted gilet.

people.title: Clara Hofstätter
people.text: Drone surveys and the 3D data they produce.

image.alternative: Portrait of Clara Hofstätter, a woman in her thirties with dark hair tied back and a navy polo shirt.

people.title: Anja Feuerstein
people.text: Subdivisions and land registry filings, from the Kettbach office.

image.alternative: Portrait of Anja Feuerstein, a woman in her late thirties wearing a taupe headscarf and a black top.

people.title: Hanno Grasser
people.text: On site four days a week. Reachable before 7:00 and after 17:00.

image.alternative: Portrait of Hanno Grasser, a bald man in his forties wearing a high-visibility jacket.

people.title: Lea Wimmer
people.text: Field work with Milan, drawing office on Thursdays, college on Fridays.

image.alternative: Portrait of Lea Wimmer, a young woman with long dark hair and a white coat.
